question: The motion of ______ body is an example of uniformly accelerated motion.
solution:
The correct answer is __**freely falling.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​A body moves in **uniformly accelerated motion** when it follows a** straight path** and experiences **constant velocity increases.**
 
• A body that is** falling freely **experiences the **acceleration caused by gravity,** hence its **acceleration is constant.**
 
• Therefore, the motion is **uniformly accelerating.**
 
• A **ball rolling down a slope, a skydiver jumping out of a plane, a ball dropped from the top of a ladder, and a bicycle with its brakes** on are a few examples of** uniformly accelerated motion.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Resting:**

 
 
• If an object** maintains its position** in relation to its **surroundings across time**, it is said to be at rest.
 
 
 
• **Decelerating:**
 
 
• The** opposite of acceleration** is deceleration.
 
• **Negative acceleration** is another name for deceleration.
 
 
 
• **Parabolic**:
 
 
• Any point on a parabola is at an equal distance from both the** focus, a fixed point, and the directrix, a fixed straight line.**
 
• A parabola is a **U-shaped plane curve. **
